verdict.rationale: Bench is a bookkeeping SaaS with a client app, so API parity with the UI is a fair question for it. The evidence documents only in-app features (messaging, uploads, reports, categorization) and inbound integrations via Plaid and tools like Shopify and Stripe. Nothing documents a public customer API, and probes for OpenAPI or Swagger specs and llms.txt all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
